en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph mounted on a light border shows a flat rural landscape with a traditional Dutch windmill standing in an open field. A drainage canal runs toward the foreground, with part of an early‑20th‑century automobile visible on the left and some small farm structures on the right. Handwritten text in Dutch appears below the photo and in the upper right margin.
